description: Purpose: identify which revenue tools a public website is built on (payment processor, CRM or lead destination, email provider, booking tool, analytics and ad pixels) and map the funnel. When to use: the user asks what stack, payment processor, CRM or tracking a site uses, or wants a funnel map; not for finding revenue leaks (that is a teardown). Inputs: url (required, a public website address); api_key (optional). Outputs: a funnel map of detected nodes, each noting what a connected check could verify end to end. Limits: free and needs no key; detects only from the public page, so server-side tools are invisible; reports no dollar findings and does not test whether anything works.

api_key.description: Optional. A Smoke Run API key. It lifts the free daily limit and is not required for a single check.

url.description: A public website address, for example https://example.com.

name: get_money_system

detected.description: False when nothing could be read from the page; the map is then empty, not an error.

paidProof.description: What a connected check can verify end to end for this node.
